text:
maria: Hey sec folks — quick ask: small PR that tweaks service-account token projection behavior for on-prem tenants. Want a fast security sanity check before I merge today. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4982
ashok: can you paste the files changed? quick scan from phone.
maria: touched: `pkg/auth/tokenproj.go`, `deploy/onprem/config.yaml`, unit tests `pkg/auth/tokenproj_test.go`. Also added a new config flag `vpc_only_token_projection` (default: false).
sec-bot: secret-scan: no high/critical secrets found in PR diff. deps-check: ok. static-analysis: 1 warning (unused var in test).
ashok: main question: does this broaden token audience or change default behavior for existing onprem installs?
maria: default behavior unchanged. New flag is opt-in and only applied when cluster has `onprem` topology label. The change scopes the projected token audience to `redwood/onprem:<tenant-id>` when enabled. Also added audit log emit when the flag is set.
olivia: quick clarifying q: How is the audience string constructed? any user-provided input concatenated?
maria: audience is `fmt.Sprintf("redwood/onprem:%s", tenant.ID)` — tenant.ID comes from our tenant DB (immutable id). No raw user input.
olivia: ok good. Couple asks before LGTM: 1) add a unit test covering blank/invalid tenant IDs (should fail safe). 2) confirm that audit log includes redacted tenant metadata, not full tokens. 3) ensure KMS envelope keys are used for any persisted token artifacts.
maria: noted — tests added in branch, will push in 10m. Audit logs already contain only tenant id and event type (no tokens). KMS: code paths for persisted blobs call `kms.EncryptEnvelope` same as other flows.
jon: from infra side: what's merge plan? if we ship to onprem customers we should canary and be ready to roll back.
maria: plan: merge to main -> canary deploy to staging onprem cluster (10% of tenant traffic) for 30m -> increase 50% if no errors -> full. Merge today at 17:00 PST if sec ok. I'll open rollback playbook.
olivia: one more: in `deploy/onprem/config.yaml` docstring please add the security rationale for the flag and recommended audit retention window. helps compliance reviewers.
maria: will add.
olivia: TL;DR: LGTM pending the extra unit test + config docstring + confirm KMS pointer in deployment template. If you push that I can stamp with an explicit :thumbsup: and we can merge.
maria: pushing test + docs now. thanks.
sec-bot: ci/status: all checks passed (unit, lint, vuln-scan) on new push.
olivia: verified tests + config note. KMS reference also present in `deploy/onprem/template.yaml`. :thumbsup: LGTM.
maria: awesome — merging at 17:00 PST. I'll monitor logs and tag @eng-oncall for a smoke window. Thanks y'all.
jon: cheers. I'll stand by for rollback if needed.
ashok: thanks, good catch on audit.
maria: (cc @olivia — will follow up if compliance wants additional retention)
